errors.text_span: вътре в секторите и около тях
errors.evidence: The description states that the percentage labels are inside and around the sectors, but all labels are located outside the sectors, pointing to the respective slices with lines.

errors.text_span: Секторите са подредени в кръг според дела им в крайното енергийно потребление
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims that the sectors are arranged in order of their share. The actual order of the slices clockwise from the top is 4.1%, 36.3%, 13.3%, 14.4%, 26.4%, and 5.5%, which is not an ordered sequence.
